verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party docs cover registrable webhook subscriptions end to end. Subscriptions can be created at organization, user, or group scope, and can be listed and deleted. The docs also provide sample data for testing, HMAC signing keys, 24-hour retries with exponential back-off, and event types for scheduling, cancellation, rescheduling and routing-form submissions, with payloads delivered in real time to the consumer's server endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery in practice.
